subjects.mecanique-generale: An open car engine bay seen from above with a completely plain, smooth engine cover (absolutely no emblem, no badge, no letter, no symbol anywhere); a hand-held diagnostic scanner lies on the fender, plugged in by its cable, a combination wrench beside it. subjects.alignement: A car on an alignment rack with wheel alignment targets clamped on the wheels. The car is a plain rounded generic compact hatchback with a small simple oval grille (NOT a large hexagonal or trapezoid grille, no real brand look), no badges, no emblems, no lettering.

hero: A local repair garage interior: a car raised on a two-post lift, a rolling tool chest and a tidy tool wall; through a high window, a wide river and flat boreal land in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#2d251d), accent highlights (#ff3c63), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers.
